_comment: Security baseline of the development image 0.0.61 (ports as proto:scope:port, LLMNR off and no sudo/pkexec/pam_timestamp_check setuid since RUY-18), checked by scripts/vm-security-check.sh (T-424). Measured with 'vm-security-check.sh measure' on a booted image. A looser value needs a reason in the same commit.

ruya-boot-marker.service.reason: root oneshot, measured 0.0.61 - barely hardened, should not ship, to be tightened (Inbox, T-425)

ruya-compositor@.service.reason: needs DRM, input and the GPU, measured 0.0.61 - barely hardened, should not ship, to be tightened (Inbox, T-425)

ruya-flathub-remote.service.reason: root oneshot with network, measured 0.0.61 - barely hardened, should not ship, to be tightened (Inbox, T-425)

ruya-grub-menu.service.reason: root oneshot that writes the GRUB custom.cfg on /boot; measured 0.0.61

ruya-inputd.service.reason: own user ruya-input, no caps, no IP; reads /dev/input, uinput; no PrivateNetwork (the udev monitor, 06-input.md section 3); measured 0.0.69-input (RUY-3)

ruya-library.service.reason: own user, no caps, no network; measured 0.0.61

ruya-session.service.reason: root, empty capability set, no network, 01-platform.md section 3 (T-162); measured 0.0.61

ports.reason: sshd, development image only (LISTEN on 0.0.0.0 and [::]); not for release (T-425)
chronyd command port (time sync), loopback; measured 0.0.61

unconfined.reason: measured 0.0.61: no SELinux policy module for ruya-* yet, every service and the shell run unconfined_service_t; a custom policy is the fix (Inbox)

setid.reason: NVIDIA driver (ADR-009), loads nvidia-uvm/device nodes for non-root users

accounts.name: root
accounts.reason: development image: root logs in over SSH with a key (key only, locked password); removed in the release profile (T-425)

xwayland_domains.reason: RUY-436 (ADR-034): the X server of an X11-only app, started on demand by the app's helper as the profile user. Fedora's policy labels /usr/bin/Xwayland xserver_t (seen on the Dell spike, RUY-1); the image adds no module for it. RUY-20 (SELinux domains for the ruya-* services) does not cover it: Xwayland is not a ruya-* process. Confirm on the first VM run of vm-x11-check.sh.
